data.title: 欧根亲王 · 空心毛衣与清晨咖啡
data.description: 明亮通透的晨光厨房内，欧根仅穿大号粗针毛衣赤足而立，领口滑落香肩。她一手端着热咖啡，一手咬着吸管向你戏谑眨眼，眼角泪痣因坏笑而格外动人。
data.location: bright airy kitchen filled with morning sunshine
data.action: standing barefoot in sunny kitchen wearing boyfriends oversized sweater slipping off shoulder, teasingly sipping from coffee mug, winking with a smug playful smirk
data.lighting: bright cheerful morning sunlight flooding through kitchen glass doors
data.mood: playful morning teasing, adorable domestic flirtation, irresistible smirk
